text:
amanda_fin: Heads-up: proposing a short A/B PAYG pricing experiment next billing cycle. Plan: 2 arms, Arm A = current PAYG, Arm B = new rate sheet (reduce embedding price, increase compute surcharge). Run length 7 days to cover invoice cut. Need finance/legal/ops/CS ack.

mark_prod: Quick clarifying q — is this a hard swap for customers in cohort B or a surcharge overlay?

amanda_fin: Hard swap for selected PAYG cohort only. No changes to reserved/enterprise. CS can flag individual customers to opt-out.

kevin_s: Can we start at 5% traffic and ramp to 25% if stable? I also want the cohort SQL and a preflight that ensures no reserved/enterprise leak.

kevin_s: ```sql
-- PAYG customers with no active commitments
SELECT id FROM customers WHERE reserved_commit IS NULL AND account_type = 'payg' AND NOT (tags && ARRAY['enterprise','reserved']) LIMIT 3000;
```

ella_ops: Ops checklist: invoice-preview sample, end-to-end billing job run, retry/backfill safety, and a rollback flag. Will run staging simulation today.

ellen_legal: Legal needs exact grandfathering text and a short CS FAQ. Also confirm tax/regulatory language will be included on invoices.

amanda_fin: Draft grandfather copy: "Customers under active reserved or enterprise contracts at cutover retain their negotiated pricing for their contract term. PAYG accounts default to the updated rates unless explicitly held back by CS."

cs_sync: CS will provide a holdlist CSV and maintain the blocklist API for on-the-fly patches during the experiment. We'll also run a diff against cohort prior to deployment.

sam_fin: Finance provisional +1 pending legal signoff. Request a 7-day soft-hold window for any accounts flagged by CS to allow manual review before billing runs.

mark_prod: Metrics to monitor: disputes/day, net revenue per cohort, invoice_error_rate, support tickets/1k customers, avg invoice latency.

amanda_fin: Go/no-go thresholds (proposed):
- disputes delta <= 0.5% absolute
- invoice_error_rate = 0
- revenue delta between cohorts within +/-3%
- support tickets spike < 20%

billing-bot: Preview bundles and accounting-format archives generated: https://billing.redwood/internal/previews/1798012345/sample_previews.zip

kevin_s: I'll add dashboards at /dashboards/pricing-experiment and wire alerts for dispute spikes and invoice schema errors. Also will schedule an automated invoice preview at day 3 and day 7.

ella_ops: Runbook steps (concise):
1) preflight: cohort list vs cs_hold diff -> abort if overlap > 0
2) deploy split 5% at T0
3) monitor thresholds for 24h, run sample invoice previews
4) if safe -> ramp to 25% at T+24h
5) if any critical alert -> trigger rollback: `billing-bot set experiment 1798012345 rollback`

ellen_legal: Legal +1 on grandfather text after we add a tax/regulatory sentence. Send final copy here and we'll sign off.

amanda_fin: Updated copy posted. Request all cross-team approvals in this thread by EOD tomorrow so we can schedule start for 2026-06-02 12:00 UTC.

sam_fin: Finance +1 (locked) after legal signs. I'll log the experiment in the billing registry and tag for a postmortem.

kevin_s: Infra +1 for traffic split. Will ensure router honors cs_hold table and that table replication completes before cut.

ella_ops: Ops +1. Staging rollback sim passed. We'll run a final preflight on day-of.

amanda_fin: Thanks everyone — consolidating approvals and will post the final runbook + dashboard links here once complete.
